for file_path in files:
    # Extract filename from path
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split by __ to get date and rest
    parts = filename.split('__')
    if len(parts) != 2:
        continue
    date_part = parts[0]
    rest = parts[1]
    # Split rest by last dot to get file_name and extension
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name, extension = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name = rest
        extension = ''
    # Create directory for file_name if not exists
    dir_path = f'~/documents/work/meetings/{file_name}/'
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dir_path, recursive=True)
    # New file name: date.extension
    new_filename = f'{date_part}.{extension}' if extension else date_part
    dest_path = f'~/documents/work/meetings/{file_name}/{new_filename}'
    # Move file
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=fs_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=dest_path)
    print(f'Moved {file_path} -> {dest_path}: {result}')
